commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
90+4' Rafa Marin (Villarreal) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Ricardo De Burgos shows a yellow card to Renato Veiga (Villarreal) for his blatant foul.

79' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
76' That will be all from Ruben Garcia who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Abel Bretones (Osasuna).

75' Marcelino decides to make a substitution. Dani Parejo will be replaced by Santi Comesana (Villarreal).
75' Today's match ends for Georges Mikautadze who will be replaced by Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal).
73' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.

70' 2 - 2 Nicolas Pepe takes over corner duties and expertly finds Gerard Moreno (Villarreal), who jumps highest and coolly plants a bullet header into the left side of the goal. The score is now 2:2.
70' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
68' Wonderful movement by Villarreal. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
66' Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.

62' Substitution. Raul Moro is replaced by Aimar Oroz (Osasuna).

58' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
57' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
52' Villarreal hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
50' Osasuna fail to score from a corner as Luiz Junior (Villarreal) leaps to collect the ball.
50' Raul Moro (Osasuna) tries his luck from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort, but it is well blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play. Osasuna win a corner kick.
48' A lofted pass finds Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) free in the box, but his first-time effort sails well wide of the left post.
46' Marcelino has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) comes on the pitch for Alfonso Pedraza.
46' Alessio Lisci has made a change at the break. Jorge Herrando has come on in place of Alejandro Catena (Osasuna).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.

45+5' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
45+5' Osasuna quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

45+2' 2 - 1 Jon Moncayola displays his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross deep into the box. Ante Budimir (Osasuna) gets onto the scoresheet by superbly heading it into the roof of the net – 2:1.

41' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
40' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
38' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) is booked.
38' The corner is swung in but Osasuna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
35' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the left post, but Sergio Herrera is prepared and dives to thwart him.
33' Villarreal take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
31' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
31' Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle as Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
30' Osasuna hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
28' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
24' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.

20' 1 - 1 Superbly taken set piece! Ruben Garcia takes the free kick and sends a cross into the six-yard box. Victor Munoz (Osasuna) flicks the ball lightly with his head towards the top of the net. Luiz Junior can't react quickly enough and the score changes to 1:1.
19' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Ricardo De Burgos had an easy-decision to make.
17' 0 - 1 Goal! Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Sergio Herrera to commit before slotting the penalty into the left of the goal.
17' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
16' Javi Galan (Osasuna) jumps into a tackle and Ricardo De Burgos signals a foul. PENALTY! One of the players from Villarreal is about to take a penalty kick. Let's see how this ends.
14' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Ricardo De Burgos stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
10' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) sends a cross into the box, but Sergio Herrera comes off his line to gather the ball.
9' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
6' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
4' Osasuna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
4' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
3' Osasuna seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
